mentions.name: Iso Hoops
mentions.description: A 3D pixel-art basketball game built with JavaScript, playable in the browser. It offers five game modes (free shooting, 10 free throws, HORSE, beat the clock, and 3pt contest) across five courts with dynamic day/night cycles, and runs fully offline with no backend.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A 3D pixel-art basketball game built with JavaScript

Play: https://vladsez.github.io/iso-hoops/

Source: https://github.com/VladSez/iso-hoops

Features:

- 5 game modes (free shooting, 10 free throws, HORSE, beat the clock, 3pt contest)

- 5 courts with dynamic day/night cycles

- offline

- no backend
